description: Join Ochieng on Lake Victoria: boats, tilapia and blessings.

choices.label: Misawa! (Greetings!)
choices.reply: Ochieng grins. "Misawa! Climb in, the lake is calm today."

choices.label: Idhi nade? (How are you?)
choices.reply: Ochieng laughs. "Idhi nade? I am well when the nets are full!"

scene1.culture: For the Luo, Lake Victoria is life itself: food, work and stories all come from its waters.
scene1.translation: "Greetings, traveller!" Ochieng waves from his wooden boat.

choices.label: Erokamano! (Thank you!)
choices.reply: You eat together, the fish smoky and delicious.

choices.label: Ber sana! (Very good!)
choices.reply: "Ber sana!" Ochieng is proud of his catch.

scene2.culture: Tilapia from Lake Victoria is the pride of Luo kitchens.
scene2.translation: "Eat fish!" Fresh tilapia sizzles over the fire.

scene3.culture: Luo farewells often come with a blessing for a safe journey.
scene3.translation: "Goodbye!" The boat drifts back across the golden water.

title: Ochieng's Fishing Morning
